_why: THE CONTRACT THIS REPO IS WRITTEN AGAINST. `pnpm sync-types` generates the API types from the aidream CHECKOUT, offline, so a deploy lag can never silently delete a field the client uses. When someone deliberately generates from a SERVER instead (`pnpm sync-types:live`), this pin is the floor: the server's git_sha (GET /health/version) must contain this commit, or the sync refuses and says the server is behind. Raise `minimum_aidream_sha` whenever this repo starts using a newly added server field. That is not a formality: this repo now reads `record_id` off `SelectedFileResponse`, so the floor moved to the commit that added it (2026-09-18) — a pin left below a field the client reads is a server that may legally answer without it.
reason: The Google Workspace registration surfaces read `record_id` (plus `record_sync_status`, `record_sync_status_reason` and `record_absent_reason`) off `SelectedFileResponse`, added in aidream 37600daa78 (F-57, R29): the Record a picked Doc's registration created, which `useOpenGoogleDocumentRecord` opens directly. This descendant of 62fa56114 also retains the canonical legal/print attribution values, the directive idempotency and the ledger-backed receipt contracts previously pinned there.
